nodes.name: Citric Acid Method Synthesis and Calcination
nodes.procedure: HESOs were synthesized using the citric acid method. Transition metal precursors and aluminum precursors were mixed with citric acid. The mixture was then processed and calcined to form the spinel structure. For Rietveld refinement analysis, MgO nanoparticles (5 wt %) were added as an indicator.
